# Agate

Agate builds a minimal interface out of overlapping transparent layers, so its recorded description asks that Obsidian's translucent window option be enabled first. The depth effect is paired with typography tuned for readability across notes and the interface itself.

![Agate screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/solm0/Agate/HEAD/agate_screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Agate"
    author: "solm0"
    repo:   "solm0/Agate"
    slug:   "agate"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/agate"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/solm0/Agate"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/solm0/Agate/HEAD/agate_screenshot.png"

    modes: ["light"]
    about: "Enable the translucent window to create a minimal interface with overlapping transparent layers and subtle depth. Enjoy refined typography tuned for smooth readability across notes and the UI."
}
```
